title: Norm-one retraction onto a finite ell-adic subfield
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with the extending nonarchimedean absolute value and its norm topology [def-weil-algebraic-closure], [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], and a finite intermediate extension $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq F\subseteq\Omega$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. There exists an $F$-linear map $p_F:\Omega\to F$ with $p_F(a)=a$ for $a\in F$ and $|p_F(x)|\leq |x|$ for every $x\in\Omega$. In particular it is continuous. No completeness of $\Omega$ is assumed.
